name: A Fur Trade
summary: Watcher Terral seeks lion hides for Farholde’s trade with a dealer at Powderfuse Port. In return, the settlement receives specialty munitions.

sections.title: Farholde’s Trade
sections.body: Farholde relies on trade for some goods, though it prizes its independence. Watcher Terral says the settlement has arranged an exchange with a dealer at Powderfuse Port. Farholde supplies goods that are dangerous to acquire, and the dealer provides specialty munitions. Now the dealer wants lion fur, and Terral asks you to bring eight Prized Lion Hides from the pride atop a large hill in the center of the plains.

faq.answer: Watcher Terral needs eight Prized Lion Hides for Farholde’s trade with a dealer at Powderfuse Port.
Farholde has arranged an exchange with a dealer at Powderfuse Port.

faq.q: What does Farholde get in the trade?
faq.answer: The dealer provides Farholde with specialty munitions.
A pride of lions lives atop a large hill in the center of the plains.
